locator.identity_review: The baseline contains one physical CDC Marsden Park campus and one six-building construction project, curated:cdc-marsden-park-campus:early-construction, for SSD-70889211. Its name, stable keys and scope remain. Original government pages independently bind the identical named point to SSD-70889211 and its Mod-1. The applicant report identifies the campus as 105 and 113 Hollinsworth Road, Lots 10 and 11 DP 1262052, and explicitly distinguishes the separately approved MP1 southwest building from the larger SSD construction project. Original risk-screening Figure 1 places the separate MP1.S1 building and the proposed MP1.S2 extension within the same overall campus; the October report maps MP1.S1 to MP1 and MP1.S2 to MP2. The government point represents the named campus; it is not an MP1 building point. The four current identity layers and all 1,291 complete site geometries identify no second host for this campus.
locator.precision: Exact literal point published by NSW Government for the named Marsden Park Data Centre project and its Mod-1, used as a representative campus locator. Replaces a legacy community-mapped polygon; no campus, parcel, building, security or current-work boundary is asserted. Six-decimal coordinates are source representation, not survey accuracy. Datum and epoch are unstated; WGS84 representation is assumed. No claim of improved positional accuracy.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Government project feature supplies no horizontal accuracy, surveyed reference, datum or epoch. It is a representative point for a multi-building campus, not a specific building or entrance.
